decisions.reason: The source adds conditional currency disclosure and selection UI rules but does not change the USDC wallet mint flow or its supported currency.
The source concerns choosing or disclosing ETH and USDC for wallet mint payments, not the deferred Transak fiat-to-USDC card flow.
Currency disclosure and selection do not alter the mint price, revenue split, or active prize-pool allocation.
The source changes payment-selection presentation, not which NFT asset must be minted and delivered.
The optional tipping feature remains unchanged regardless of how the base mint payment currency is disclosed or selected.
The source requires the customer to see the applicable currency during payment but does not necessarily change the separately maintained FAQ content.
Payment-currency selection does not change the rule that only successfully minted, actually owned NFTs appear on the dashboard.
The source's use of selection refers to payment currency, not prize-winner selection or Chainlink VRF rules.
The source does not change confirmation-email availability, contents, certificate actions, or ebook access.
Primary-mint payment disclosure and selection do not affect secondary-sale royalty enforcement or marketplace controls.
The NFT mint number remains the permanent referral code regardless of which supported payment currency is shown or selected.
Payment-currency selection does not change the commission, ticket, trigger, or random-recipient rules for no-code mints.
